title: 30 Minutes Powerful Prayer For Financial Breakthrough
text: Beloved in Christ, hear me clearly tonight. God never designed scarcity to be the identity of his covenant children. From Genesis to Revelation, the picture of God's covenant is abundance, multiplication, and overflow. In Genesis 1:28, the Bible says, "And God blessed them." And God said unto them, "Be fruitful and multiply, and replenish the earth, and subdue it." This is the first voice that man heard, blessing, fruitfulness, multiplication. Scarcity was not in the blueprint of Eden. Scarcity was not in the covenant of Abraham. Scarcity is not in the new covenant in Christ Jesus. If you are truly the seed of Abraham, then you must contend until your life reflects covenant wealth and kingdom resources. Deuteronomy 8:18 declares, "But thou shalt remember the Lord thy God, for it is he that giveth thee power to get wealth, that he may establish his covenant, which he swear unto thy fathers, as it is this day." The power to get wealth is real. And tonight as we engage prayer, that power will come upon your hands, upon your mind, upon your spirit, and you will rise from scarcity to overflow. I announce prophetically before this year ends, your financial breakthrough must manifest. Not by chance, not by luck, but by prophecy, by warfare, and by alignment to kingdom principles. Isaiah 65 says, "Then thou shalt see and flow together, and thine heart shall fear and be enlarged, because the abundance of the sea shall be converted unto thee. The forces of the Gentiles shall come unto thee." Forces mean wealth, influence, resources. God is saying the resources of nations will locate you. Someone under the sound of my voice. Your years of walking like an elephant and eating like an ant are over. By the mystery of prophetic intercession, God is rewriting the financial story of your family. The season of hand-to-mouth existence is terminated. I decree and declare every curse of financial hardship is broken over your life. Every generational embgo on wealth is shattered. Every spirit of waste that devours resources is rebuked. Every demonic pattern of loss and debt is destroyed. From today, the blessing of Abraham speaks over your life. Pray with violence. By the blood of Jesus, I silence every ancestral voice of lack. By the fire of God, I scatter every monitoring spirit that tracks my harvest. By divine authority, I decree consistent supplies. By the word of God, I legislate prosperity. Listen carefully. In the realm of the spirit, money is not just currency. It is a force. Ecclesiastes 7:12 says, "For wisdom is a defense and money is a defense." That means lack of money exposes you. Many destinies are suffering not because they are lazy, but because altars have said, "You will never rise financially." But tonight those altars must scatter. Prophetic utterance. Thus sayaith the spirit of God. Someone here has been mocked because of financial shame, but within the next 90 days, the Lord will turn your mockery into testimony. Another person, every time money enters your hand, strange sickness arises and swallows it. Thus sayeth the Lord, the spirit that eats your resources is judged. Now lift your voice. By the blood of Jesus, I uproot the altar of poverty in my foundation. By the fire of God, I destroy every chain tying me to financial failure. By divine authority, I command wealth to locate me. By the word of God, I receive power to get wealth over your business. Deuteronomy 28:12 says, "The Lord shall open unto thee his good treasure, the heaven to give the rain unto thy land in his season, and to bless all the work of thine hand, and thou shalt lend unto many nations, and thou shalt not borrow." Hear me, the days of borrowing are over. Beloved, there is wealth for the end time church. Hagi 2:8 says, "The silver is mine and the gold is mine, sayaeth the Lord of hosts." That means you cannot be broke when your father owns silver and gold. Psalm 24:1 says, "The earth is the Lord's and the fullness thereof." This earth is not in the hand of the devil. It belongs to your father. Dominion includes financial dominion. Pray with boldness. By the blood of Jesus, I align with kingdom wealth. By the fire of God, I destroy covenants of financial slavery. By divine authority, I command resources to answer me. By the word of God, I take my portion in the land of the living. Now, lift your worship. Father, you are the El Shadai, the allsufficient one. You are Jehovah Gyra, the provider. You are my shepherd. I shall not want. You daily load me with benefits. To you belongs glory, honor, riches, and power. And I decree and declare prophetically before this year ends. Your financial breakthrough must manifest. You will not cross into another year with shame. You will not end this year empty-handed. The God who makes rivers in the desert will surprise you. The covenant keeping God will remember you. The Lord of hosts will fight for your financial settlement. In the name of Jesus, I decree your banks will be filled with plenty. Your v will overflow with new wine. Your pors will never be empty. Your life will testify that Jehovah has blessed you. Amen and amen. The title he has placed before us is this. Angels of finances, locate me now. Supernatural provision prayer, business breakthrough by fire, contracts, clients and cash flow. Hear me, child of God. There is such a reality as angelic ministry in the area of resources, in the area of wealth, in the area of provision. Psalm 24:1 declares, "The earth is the Lord." Hebrews 1:14 reveals, "Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for those who will inherit salvation?" Angels are not only protectors, they are also messengers, warriors, and carriers of provision. In First Kings 19:6, an angel brought food to Elijah in the wilderness. In Matthew 4:11, after Jesus resisted the devil, angels came and ministered to him, there are angels assigned to the saints for provision. Today, we call them forth into action. I tell you by the spirit of God, the lack you see in your life is not because God is unfaithful. It is because access has been hindered, doors have been shut, and sometimes covenants have been broken in the wrong direction. But this morning, by prayer and by the decrees of the spirit, those hindrances will be lifted, those doors will be opened, and those angels will be released. Let your faith rise because Deuteronomy 8:18 declares, "And you shall remember the Lord your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth that he may establish his covenant which he swore to your fathers as it is this day." The covenant of God is to empower you for wealth. Not just for selfish luxury, but to establish his kingdom, to sponsor his agenda, to advance his purposes. Lift your voice and thank him. Father, I thank you because you are my source. You are Jehovah Gyra, the God who provides. Thank you because provision is already made in Christ. Thank you because I will not l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l l lack I will not beg I will not borrow now I decree and declare angels of finances locate God's people now wherever your helpers are wherever your contracts are wherever your clients are wherever your opportunities are let angels of the Lord bring them to you Psalm 68:19 says blessed Blessed be the Lord who daily loads us with benefits. The God of our salvation. Today's benefits will not pass you by. I speak, I decree by fire, every covenant of poverty, every cause of financial hardship break in the name of Jesus. 2 Corinthians 8:9 says, "For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich." By covenant you are not permitted to remain poor. I prophesy abundance. Psalm 23:1 says, "The Lord is my shepherd. I shall not want. Your days of want are over. Your days of lack are over. You will not run from creditor to creditor. You will not live under the yoke of scarcity. You will live in abundance. You will walk in overflow. I speak into your hands. Whatever you touch prospers. Psalm 13 says, "He shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water that brings forth its fruit in its season, whose leaf also shall not wither, and whatever he does shall prosper, your business prospers, your work prospers, your ideas prosper." Lift your voice again and declare, "By the blood of Jesus, I step into supernatural provision. By the power of the cross, I step into abundance. By the anointing of the spirit, I step into overflow. [Music] Now listen, child of God. Every financial delay, every withheld payment, every denied contract, I command release now. Ecclesiastes 5:19 says, "As for every man to whom God has given riches and wealth and given him power to eat of it, to receive his heritage and rejoice in his labor. This is the gift of God. Receive your portion. And now I decree favor." Psalm 44:3 says, "For they did not gain possession of the land by their own sword, nor did their own arms save them, but it was your right hand, your arm, and the light of your countenance because you favored them." Favor that opens doors, favor that brings clients, favor that. Beloved, hear me as I speak by the spirit of God. Financial struggles are not just natural. They are spiritual. Behind closed doors in the realm of the spirit, there are covenants, sacrifices, and voices that contend with your rising. Lamentations 5:2 says, "Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens." There are many today who labor, but strangers eat the fruit. You gather and another man harvest it. You build and another man occupies it. Tonight, by the authority of the blood of Jesus, such manipulation comes to an end. Lift your voice. By the blood of Jesus, I retrieve every inheritance stolen from my family. By the fire of God, I recover every land, every property, every resource that was hijacked. By divine authority, I break every satanic agreement that traded my wealth. By the word of God, I reclaim my portion. The Bible says in Zechariah 1:17, "Cry yet, saying, Thus sayaeth the Lord of hosts. My cities through prosperity shall yet be spread abroad, and the Lord shall yet comfort Zion, and shall yet choose Jerusalem." That means prosperity is a prophetic mandate for kingdom expansion. The gospel travels on the wings of wealth. Hear me. You are not asking for money for vanity. You are demanding what is required to fulfill destiny. Thus, saith the spirit of God. There is someone under the sound of my voice. Every time you attempt to save, there is a mysterious emergency. Tonight, the devourer is rebuked for your sake. Malachi 3:11. Another person. Your family has lived in rented houses for decades. But before this year ends, God will hand you keys of your own home. Now pray violently. By the blood of Jesus, I stop the hand of the devourer. By the fire of God, I destroy financial leeches in my destiny. By divine authority, I command wealth to multiply. By the word of God, I legislate ownership of properties. Prophetic decree, I speak multiplication to your seed, multiplication to your job, multiplication to your skills, multiplication to your network. Every limitation on your capacity to increase is shattered. Now declare aggressively, by the blood of Jesus, my resources will multiply. By the fire of God, my jars will overflow. By divine authority, I decree exponential increase. By the word of God, I receive supernatural multiplication. Thus, sayeth the spirit of the Lord, someone here has been laboring under ancestral covenants of poverty, where no matter how hard you try, wealth never stays in your hand. But this night, the covenant is broken. another person. Your name has been written in demonic registers of death. Tonight, your name is blotted out by the blood of Jesus. The Bible says in Isaiah 10:27, "And it shall come to pass in that day that his burden shall be taken away from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing." Poverty is a yoke. Depth is a yoke. Insufficiency is a yoke. I decree every yoke on your finances is destroyed. Lift your prayer. By the blood of Jesus, every financial yoke breaks by the fire of God. Every chain of debt scatters. By divine authority, I release myself from captivity. By the word of God, I walk in liberty and abundance. Psalm 112:3 says, "Wealth and riches shall be in his house, and his righteousness endureth forever." This is your portion. Wealth and riches are not for unbelievers alone. They are covenant portions for the righteous. You will not just survive, you will thrive. Pray militantly by the blood of Jesus. Wealth and riches enter my house. By the fire of God, I reject lack and insufficiency. By divine authority, I command resources to answer me. By the word of God, the atmosphere is open. The heavens are ready and angels are already on assignment. This morning is not ordinary. It is a prophetic appointment where God himself is releasing financial destiny, help, contracts, clients, and cash flow. For it is written in Psalm 68:19, "Blessed be the Lord who daily loads us with benefits, the God of our salvation." Hear me. Resources are not scarce. It is access that has been denied. Opportunities are not finished. It is alignment that has been missing. But by prayer, alignment is restored. Access is granted. Doors are opened. 2 Corinthians 9:8 says, "And God is able to make all grace abound toward you that you always having all sufficiency in all things may have an abundance for every good work. All grace, financial grace, business grace, favor grace is abounding toward you. Now lift your hands and declare, "Father, I receive grace for financial abundance. I receive grace for supernatural provision. I receive grace for open doors. I decree and declare angels of finances locate them now. Wherever your name is mentioned for contracts, may the spirit of God give you favor. Wherever your proposals are line forgotten, may the angels of remembrance stir them up again. Wherever your opportunities have been delayed, may divine acceleration bring them forward now. Isaiah 65 says, "Then you shall see and become radiant, and your heart shall swell with joy because the abundance of the sea shall be turned to you. The wealth of the Gentiles shall come to you. I decree the wealth of the nations comes into your hands. Systems will favor you. Policies will favor you. Men will favor you. I prophesy divine clients. In Luke 5:6-7, Peter toiled all night and caught nothing. But when Jesus stepped in, the net broke with abundance. I decree in the name of Jesus, I decree supernatural preservation of wealth. Hagi 2:8 says, "The silver is mine and the gold is mine, says the Lord of hosts. No devourer will eat your resources. No thief will steal your harvest. No demonic system will divert your cash flow. Lift your voice again. Say, in the name of Jesus, I walk into financial favor. I walk into abundance. I walk into overflow. By the authority of scripture, I prophesy contracts released. Isaiah 45:3 says, "I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, hidden contracts, hidden opportunities, hidden treasures be unveiled to you now. I speak to your finances multiply." 2 Kings 4:2-7 shows us the widow whose oil multiplied supernaturally until there was overflow. I decree multiplication. Your little will become much. Your seed will become a harvest. Your work will become a stream of wealth. I prophesy strategic connections. Ruth met Boaz by divine orchestration and her story changed forever. I decree may God align you with Boa's connections, men and women of influence who will favor you, who will invest in you, who will recommend you, who will open doors for you. Now pray aggressively. [Music] Chains are breaking, doors are opening, angels are working. I decree restoration. Joel 2:25-26 says, "So I will restore to you the years that the swarming locust has eaten, you shall eat in plenty and be satisfied. Every year eaten by poverty. Every month wasted in depth. Every opportunity consumed by lack be restored in the name of Jesus.
